sentences.text:
This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.572/2023 dated 30.7.2023 registered at Police Station Civil lines,
District - Chhatarpur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 376(2)(n), 376(1), 450,
323, 506, 34 of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.

Applicant is in detention since 2.12.2023.
2.

sentences.text: She was recovered on 14.9.2023 and in her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. prosecutrix stated that Akhilesh, Veeru and Suraj forcibly kidnapped her and took her to Bina.
Thereafter, they took her to Shimla by train, where she remained with Suraj.
At Shimla, Suraj used to commit rape upon her.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.

There are no allegation against him about rape/
aggravated penetrative sexual assault.
Main allegation is against Suraj.
The only allegation against him is of kidnapping the prosecutrix which is false.
He has been implicated only because he is friend of Suraj.
It is submitted that prosecutrix was having love affair with Suraj and she on her own had gone with Suraj.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.

4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail but learned counsel for the victim has submitted that victim has no objection if the applicant is released on bail.

5. Considering the totality of allegations against the present applicant and the fact that victim has no objection in releasing the applicant on bail, but without expressing anything on the merit of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6 . It is directed that applicant - Akhilesh Ahirwar be released on bail on h is furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
